card.name: Christian prayer and faith language
card.fires_on: Small words (ask, for, the, with, He, 's) in religious Christian passages about prayer, God, Jesus or the Spirit, right where a request or divine action is about to be named.

modes.label: Asking God
modes.description: The verb ask or the word for in sentences about praying to God or Jesus.
modes.example: In your prayers, thank God for the gift of unity he has blessed you with and<< ask>> Him to help you both in your efforts

modes.label: Linking words in devotional text
modes.description: Short linking words in sermon-like or catechism-like sentences, just before a spiritual term.
modes.example: a noble man does not get drunk on wine but is instead filled with<< the>> Spirit; a noble man does not love

card.writes: It seems to push toward Chinese words for guidance and truth, such as 指导 and 真理, giving a spiritual-guidance flavor.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in Christian writing about praying and being guided by God.
